_note: Which model does which job. Code asks for a ROLE (talking_shot, keyframe...) and models.py resolves it to the first usable candidate; no script should name a model id itself. A candidate is usable when status is 'active' and it is priced in pipeline/prices.json (or billing is 'free'). To swap or retire a model: change status here, add its price (spend.py price MODEL CREDITS --per ...), run `python3 pipeline/models.py check`. 'shape' marks candidates whose request differs (a caller that only knows one shape passes shape=...). Env: MODEL_<ROLE>=id forces a model; MODEL_UNAVAILABLE=id,id skips models a vendor has pulled.
